summary: In the United States, Bosentan has a boxed warning for risks of liver damage and harm to an unborn baby [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high score of 70 for liver concerns [M]. The same computer model gave the drug a low score of 39 for heart issues [M].
